package mini

// Go versions of engine.c, for checking results bit for bit.

func refLeafMix(a, b int64) int64 { return (a * 31) ^ (b + 7) }
func refLeafF(a float64, b int64) float64 {
	x := float64(a * 0.5)
	return x + float64(b)
}

func refMid(ssp uint64, vu uint64, vtag int64, d float64) (uint64, int64) {
	x := refLeafMix(int64(vu), vtag)
	y := refLeafF(d, 3)
	return uint64(x) + uint64(y) + ssp, vtag + 1
}

func refHost(ssp, depth uint64, x float64) uint64 {
	r := hostResult(ssp, depth, x)
	if int64(depth) > 0 {
		u, tag := refOuter(ssp+256, r, int64(depth), x*0.5, int64(depth)-1)
		r ^= u + uint64(tag)*3
	}
	return r
}

func refOuter(ssp uint64, vu uint64, vtag int64, d float64, depth int64) (uint64, int64) {
	a0 := int64(vu) + 1
	a1 := vtag * 3
	a2 := depth ^ 0x55
	a3 := a0 * a1
	a4 := a2 + a3
	a5 := a4 * 7
	a6 := a5 ^ a0
	a7 := a6 + a2
	a8 := a7*5 + 1
	a9 := a8 ^ a3
	a10 := a9 + a4
	a11 := a10 * 9
	f0 := d + 1.0
	f1 := float64(d * 2.0)
	f2 := float64(f0 * f1)
	f3 := f2 - d
	f4 := float64(f3 * 1.5)
	f5 := f4 + f0
	f6 := float64(f5 * 0.25)
	f7 := f6 + f2
	f8 := float64(f7 * 3.0)
	f9 := f8 - f1
	h := int64(refHost(ssp+64, uint64(depth), f9))
	mu, mtag := refMid(ssp+128, vu, vtag, f3)
	h2 := int64(refHost(ssp+192, uint64(depth), f5))
	s := a0 + a1 + a2 + a3 + a4 + a5 + a6 + a7 + a8 + a9 + a10 + a11
	t := f0 + f1
	t += f2
	t += f3
	t += f4
	t += f5
	t += f6
	t += f7
	t += f8
	t += f9
	ru := (uint64(s) ^ uint64(h) ^ (uint64(h2) << 1)) + mu + uint64(int64(t))
	rtag := mtag + refLeafMix(s, h)
	return ru, rtag
}
